items.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Unveils Shirudo for Real Time AI Cyber Defense
items.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS: CSCO) and OpenAI announced Shirudo, a self-defending AI cybersecurity system for enterprises. Shirudo uses eBPF based agents to observe low level infrastructure activity and trigger real time automated threat responses. The platform is released as open source software, inviting enterprise security teams and developers to contribute and extend its capabilities. items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Stock May Be 29% Undervalued As AI Security News Builds
items.summary: Cisco Systems has delivered strong multi year share gains. With a recent pullback on the chart, the key question is whether the current price still aligns with the cash the business is expected to generate. Over the past 3 years, Cisco Systems has returned about 112%. This places significant focus on whether that share price climb is supported by the durability and level of its future cash flows.
